technique_name: Provide a solution to improve the reliability of the software system
description: A solution to improve the reliability of the software system is to use a software testing process. Software testing can help identify potential problems early in the development process and ensure that the final product meets the desired requirements. Additionally, software testing should also include regular performance testing and stress testing in order to ensure the software system can handle real-world conditions.
